div.div: Each item here is one that the next year records, such as a cutoff difference, so it reverses there. A balance that persists, such as one with no document behind it, does not reverse and needs an analysis of its own. An error that recurs every year can leave income nearly right while the balance sheet stays wrong.

div.div: The facts existed at the year-end and were missed or misapplied. The correction goes to the period in which they existed: when the error is material to the prior statements, the prior year's figures are restated, and an earlier error enters opening retained earnings.

div.div: The year-end estimate was reasonable on the facts then available. A later difference goes to the period in which it becomes known, and to later periods if they are affected. Nothing is restated.
